verdict.rationale: Medusa's core commerce modules are open-source, MIT-licensed and freely available on npm, and Medusa can be installed by the user. That makes the core product self-hostable rather than tied to Medusa Cloud, which is positioned as an optional managed-infrastructure offering. missing for 10: explicit first-party self-hosting/deployment guide in the evidence, hands-on corroboration of a production self-hosted deployment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
